note: KDWP park on 80-acre Meade State Lake (no-wake, fishing boats only) in the southwest Kansas high plains: 42 water/electric sites in four loops (Lakeview on the north shore, Cedar, Cottonwood, Sagebrush - the last 8 are long-term sites) plus primitive areas around the lake, shower house, swim beach, tornado shelters. Open year round; reserve on campitks.gov or self-register. A May 2026 wildfire closed some primitive areas and the trails; the park reopened May 21, 2026 with the only entrance from Highway 23 - check with the office. --Claude
